name: NVIDIA (NIM)
short: NVIDIA NIM inference microservices — free hosted endpoints for prototyping NVIDIA and partner models, then self-host or buy AI Enterprise.

plans.name: Free hosted endpoints
plans.notes: All catalog models are free to prototype; up to 40 RPM for most models, no per-token billing.

plans.name: Self-hosted NIM
plans.price: Free under license; you pay for the GPUs
plans.notes: Download the same NIM container for your own cloud or a CSP partner (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).

plans.name: NVIDIA AI Enterprise
plans.notes: Production Branch, enterprise support and security maintenance; a 90-day trial is available.
